reasoning_content: The Settings classes require multiple environment variables. bmds-api: URL_ORIGINAL, URL_REPLACEMENT, PREFECT_FLOW_NAME. bmds-executors: 5 MICROSERVICE_*_URLs. I'll provide them all and retest — this will prove that the package installation is correct, and only the runtime configuration is missing (which the guide explicitly states is required).

action.command:
echo "== bmds-api (URL_ORIGINAL/URL_REPLACEMENT/PREFECT_FLOW_NAME):"
docker run --rm -e URL_ORIGINAL=a -e URL_REPLACEMENT=b -e PREFECT_FLOW_NAME=x -e PREFECT_API_URL=http://localhost:4200/api --entrypoint sh demospipes-bmds-api -c 'cd /app && python -c "import demospipes_addon_bmds_api; print(\"BMDS-API IMPORT OK\")"' 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "== bmds-executors (5 microservice URLs):"
docker run --rm -e MICROSERVICE_DATA_SERVICE_URL=http://a -e MICROSERVICE_DEMOS_EINWENDUNGSMANAGEMENT_SERVICES=http://b -e MICROSERVICE_PDF_PROCESSOR_URL=http://c -e MICROSERVICE_NORM_MATCHING_URL=http://d -e MICROSERVICE_SUBSUMTION_URL=http://e -e PREFECT_API_URL=http://localhost:4200/api --entrypoint sh demospipes-bmds-executors -c 'cd /app && python -c "import demospipes_addon_bmds_executors; print(\"BMDS-EXEC IMPORT OK\")"' 2>&1 | tail -1
